content: If <Up>_[SoAd][Tp] StartOfReception () or <Up>_[SoAd] [Tp] Copy RxData() return with BUFREQ_ E_NOT_ OK for a socket connection with PDU Header mode disabled, SoAd shall (a) d isable further transmission or reception for this socket connect ion (i.e. new transmit requests shall be rejected with E_NOT_OK and received messages shall simply be discarded) and (b) close the socket connection in the next SoAd_MainFunction() .
